headline: ADNOC Signs 10-Year LNG Supply Deal With India's Gujarat Energy
summary: ADNOC agreed to supply up to 4 million tons of LNG to India's Gujarat Energy over ten years, starting in 2028. This marks the first international gas portfolio agreement for ADNOC's investment company, XRG.
why: ADNOC is a major state-owned energy producer in the United Arab Emirates, playing a critical role in global oil and liquefied natural gas markets and international energy supply agreements.

impacts.name: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company
impacts.why: ADNOC secured a long-term supply agreement for its international gas portfolio.
